subject: Recruitment Question
text:
Hi James,

Got a recruitment question you might have some perspective on. We are looking to replace some skills in house. At the moment, we are even considering replacing people with other new roles. I am considering
 hiring (either permanent or say 1yr fixed term contract) an ML Vision Engineer. They would be responsible for understanding the client briefs (that tend to be along similar lines), designing the best approach for annotations and model training, guiding the
 development of the technology (a bit of coding but mostly supported) and helping get results to analysts in way they can generate insights.

I’m guessing this is something you have come across before. Do you have any idea of a salary expectation for such a role?

Regards,

Chris.
